dataset: legacy Training/Testing split (2870 train / 393 test) recorded at training time in the legacy notebook; original images not distributed with this repository

recorded_training_metrics.source: recorded in the legacy notebook at training time, not independently re-verified

case_study.input: Hirnmetastase_MRT-T1_KM.jpg (T1-weighted contrast-enhanced brain MRI showing a metastasis)
case_study.verdict: Out of label space. A brain metastasis is not one of the 4 supported classes; the softmax is forced to normalize over them for any input, so a high nominal No Tumor probability is not evidence of absence of tumor.
case_study.preprocessing_match: Inference reproduces the legacy training preprocessing (RGB, PIL bilinear 64x64, float32/255); no drift found.

calibration.reason: ECE requires a labelled held-out set, which is not distributed with this repository
calibration.honest_labeling: Results are surfaced as 'model probability' (never confidence) in UI, PDF and API

abstention: Results below a 60% model-probability threshold are marked 'Classification unavailable' in the UI instead of being presented as a decision.
notes: No OOD detector is present: in-label-space but unusual images can still receive a high nominal probability.
Temperature scaling is not applicable because the inference path returns post-softmax probabilities rather than raw logits (documented in training/evaluate.py).
Fix requires retraining with additional classes or an out-of-distribution rejection head, followed by measured ECE.
